prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preview Your Desktop Companion", "See how your pet looks and moves on desktop standard backgrounds before completing adoption."]
1: ["Verifying Desktop Environment", "Checking overlay permissions and display settings so your pet renders smoothly over active windows."]
2: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Quick shortcuts to summon, move, or hide your companion anytime while you work.", "Right-click your pet for quick actions, double-click to chat."]
3: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Select a ready-to-adopt companion for instant launch or build your own custom pet."]
4: ["Your pet progress and collections automatically sync to your account safe and sound.", "Cloud Save Active"]
5: ["Generating your 3D pet model and desktop behaviors... almost ready!"]
6: ["Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P to bring your pet to your active screen!"]
7: ["Sign in to activate automatic cloud backup and protect your pet state across all desktop sessions.", "Instant Cloud Protection"]
8: ["Instant Pet (1 min) vs Custom Pet (3 min). You can always create more pets later!"]
9: ["Pet is now active! Find the desktop tray icon to adjust settings anytime.", "Taskbar icon enabled for instant controls"]
